description: Add a searchable text layer to a scanned PDF, making it selectable and searchable. Use this before extracting text from a scan or a photographed document. Scans at 300 DPI or higher read well; below 150 DPI the result degrades badly.

file.description: Absolute path to the scanned PDF.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: ocr_pdf
